title: Christmas Greenery Watercolor Clipart
author: clemencian
description:
🎄 Christmas Greenery Watercolor Clipart Collection 🎀
Bring the warmth and beauty of Christmas to your creative projects with this charming collection of 11 festive watercolor illustrations. Featuring elegant pine branches, pinecones, bright red berries, holly leaves, gingerbread star cookies, a beautiful red ribbon bow, candy cane, dried orange slice, mistletoe, poinsettia, and a delicate golden Christmas bell.
Designed in a traditional hand-painted watercolor style, this collection combines rich forest greens, festive reds, warm browns, and soft golden accents. Perfect for creating cozy, rustic, vintage-inspired, and elegant Christmas designs.
✨ WHAT’S INCLUDED
✔ 11 Christmas Watercolor Clipart Elements
✔ Pine Branches with Pinecones
✔ Red Christmas Ribbon Bow
✔ Red Winter Berry Branch
✔ Gingerbread Star Cookie
✔ Christmas Holly with Red Berries
✔ Red and White Candy Cane
✔ Dried Orange Slice with Cloves
✔ Red Christmas Poinsettia
✔ Pine Greenery with Red Berries
✔ Christmas Mistletoe with White Berries
✔ Golden Christmas Bell
